main.description: Network-wide settings and the admin list. Stored in the network's repo. Signed by the network root key (#neuros_root in the network DID document).

network.description: The network DID. Must match the repo this record is stored in.

seq.description: Increases with every new config. Nodes reject a config with a lower seq than one they have seen.

ipv6Prefix.description: Optional IPv6 ULA /96. A node's IPv6 address is this prefix followed by its 32 IPv4 bits.

maxApprovalSeconds.description: Longest allowed approval lifetime. Also how long nodes keep a revocation. Suggested: 2592000 (30 days).

signature.description: Made with the network root key.

keys.description: did:keys this admin signs with, usually one per admin device.

ipv4Range.description: The part of the network's ipv4Prefix this admin assigns addresses from. Admin ranges must not overlap.
